text: Hi, Alice. What have you been doing?
I stayed up late last night to watch the Olympics.
We won a gold medal for men’s basketball.
We also won the silver medal for women’s tennis.
The men’s team didn’t do so well.
But the women’s team won the silver medal.
I haven’t had much time to watch, but I saw the opening ceremony.
What have you been doing this summer?
I’ve been playing baseball and taking swimming lessons.
Maybe I can come and watch your team play some time.
We have a game this weekend.
Why don’t you come and watch us play in the park?
Sure! Just let me know what time the game starts. See you later.
